The default value for FlatCAM units.
Whatever is selected here is set every time
FlatCAM is started.

Choose what graphic engine to use in FlatCAM.
Legacy(2D) -> reduced functionality, slow performance but enhanced compatibility.
OpenGL(3D) -> full functionality, high performance
Some graphic cards are too old and do not work in OpenGL(3D) mode, like:
Intel HD3000 or older. In this case the plot area will be black therefore
use the Legacy(2D) mode.

Choose the default level of usage for FlatCAM.
BASIC level -> reduced functionality, best for beginner's.
ADVANCED level -> full functionality.

The choice here will influence the parameters in
the Selected Tab for all kinds of FlatCAM objects.

Choose if the application should run as portable.

If Checked the application will run portable,
which means that the preferences files will be saved
in the application folder, in the lib\config subfolder.

The number of Qthreads made available to the App.
A bigger number may finish the jobs more quickly but
depending on your computer speed, may make the App
unresponsive. Can have a value between 2 and 16.

This value can counter the effect of the Circle Steps

performance. Higher value will provide more
performance at the expense of level of detail.

The NC drill files, usually named Excellon files
are files that can be found in different formats.
Here we set the format used when the provided
coordinates are not using period.

Possible presets:

PROTEUS 3:3 MM LZ
DipTrace 5:2 MM TZ
DipTrace 4:3 MM LZ

EAGLE 3:3 MM TZ
EAGLE 4:3 MM TZ
EAGLE 2:5 INCH TZ
EAGLE 3:5 INCH TZ

ALTIUM 2:4 INCH LZ
Sprint Layout 2:4 INCH LZ
KiCAD 3:5 INCH TZ
Default values for INCH are 2:4

- 'Ext' -> will isolate only on the outside

If checked, use 'rest machining'.
Basically it will process copper outside PCB features,
using the biggest tool and continue with the next tools,
from bigger to smaller, to process the copper features that
could not be processed by previous tool, until there is
nothing left to process or there are no more tools.
